[[File:GungiLightsaber-BFR.png|thumb|250px|Gungi's lightsaber was made of wood from the Brylark.]]
{{Quote|Ah... yes, wood. Not a common choice. And only wood from a Brylark tree is as strong as metal.|[[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]]|<ref name="A Test of Strength">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref>}}
The '''Brylark tree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]] was asked by [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]] what he envisioned his future [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to be made. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] explained to the [[Architect droid/Legends|Architect droid]] he felt it through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as [[Wood/Legends|wood]]. Huyang responded that the only wood sturdy enough to make a saber would be from a Brylark tree. Huyang had a pre-carved Brylark wood casing in his collection of lightsaber parts, which Gungi used for his [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]]. Huyang said that it was a very rare choice among hilts, just like Wookiees like Gungi are rare among Jedi.
